description: Premium tea brand founded in 1992 that sparked a specialty tea revolution; sells 350+ all-natural premium teas and herbal blends (organic SuperAdapt, SuperGreen, U-Matcha, bottled iced teas) plus teaware, with certifications including USDA Organic, Non-GMO Project and OU Kosher.

evidence.summary: The brand's own affiliate page lists 4% commission on sales for new customers and 4% for returning customers, a 30-day cookie, product data feed and banners, with an 'Apply Now' button that links to app.impact.com — the current program runs on Impact.

CONFLICT: multiple affiliate directories (Brandid, LinkClicky, ThriversHub) describe an older ShareASale program at 8% for new customers / 4% returning with a 30-day cookie. This conflicts with the brand's own current page (4%/4% via Impact), so commission_rate is recorded as null.
Homepage confirms 350+ premium teas and herbs, 'Trusted Since 1992', a subscription program and press features (Food & Wine, Bustle, Brit+Co).

name: The Republic of Tea

opportunity.title: The Republic of Tea Affiliate Program — 4% new / 4% returning via Impact (own page); directories conflict with an older 8%/4% ShareASale listing

reasons.compensation: Own page states only 4%/4%, and third-party directories conflict with an older 8%/4% ShareASale listing, so the rate is recorded null and compensation scores low.
reasons.contact_access: Public affiliate page with a direct Apply Now route into Impact; no public partnerships email was found on fetched pages.
reasons.credibility: Founded 1992, 350+ teas, USDA Organic / Non-GMO / Kosher certifications and national press features.
reasons.niche_fit: Premium tea is a core food-drink niche with strong gifting and wellness angles (adaptogen, green and matcha lines).
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open application through Impact with a 30-day cookie and data feed.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Brand runs an active affiliate program with banners, a product feed and regular affiliate emails, but no public creator-content program details were found.

description: Insulated stainless steel water bottle brand built for athletes (the ATLYS One); a portion of every sale supports the Inspiring Children Foundation's youth mental-health mentorship, and its roster of pro athlete ambassadors spans the NFL, NBA, NHL and MLB.

evidence.summary: ATLYS Athletes is the brand's own commission program, open to U.S. residents at every level from grade school to the pros: apply, get hand-approved, receive a personal code/link, and earn $5 for every ATLYS One sold through it while followers get 10% off. The page states plainly it is commission-based — no free product or merch for joining.

The program's own Terms of Use (Atlys LLC, an Arizona limited liability company; last updated August 5, 2026) set the commission at a flat $5 per Qualifying Sale, paid monthly with a low $5.00 minimum payout threshold; affiliates may keep earnings or direct 100% to a chosen cause.

name: Atlys

opportunity.title: ATLYS Athletes — flat $5 per bottle sold through your code/link (brand's own program, terms on site)

reasons.compensation: Flat $5 per bottle on the brand's own published terms, paid monthly with only a $5 threshold — modest per-sale pay but fully transparent and verified.
reasons.contact_access: Open application page on the brand's own site plus a published company email in the program terms.
reasons.credibility: Named NFL/NBA/NHL ambassadors and a stated charitable give-back per sale; young brand, so one point held back.
reasons.niche_fit: Hydration/fitness product with an athlete-first program design; strong fit for sports, gym and outdoor creators.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to U.S. residents at every level, grade school through pro; every application is reviewed by hand.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The brand publicly showcases a roster of named pro athletes in the program and builds content around athlete codes.

description: Organic period, bladder and body care brand (tampons, pads, liners, cups, discs and underwear) sold by subscription and one-time purchase; with every purchase Cora provides period products and body-literacy resources to people who might otherwise go without, and says it has donated over 10 million pads since 2016.

evidence.summary: Lasso's program page lists Cora at a flat $5 per sale in the Women's Health category, and its 'Join the Cora affiliate program' link routes to auth.rakutenmarketing.com — the program runs on Rakuten Advertising. Cookie duration is not published.

Homepage confirms organic period and body care delivered by subscription or one-time buy, and the give-back model: products and body-literacy resources provided with every purchase; over 10 million pads donated since 2016.

reasons.contact_access: Join route is via the Lasso program page into Rakuten; no public partnerships email found on fetched pages.
reasons.credibility: Well-known consumer brand with a documented give-back record (10M+ pads donated since 2016) and major press logos on its homepage.
reasons.niche_fit: Organic period and body care is a strong women's-health niche with subscription repeat purchases.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open network application on Rakuten Advertising; approval typically takes a few days per Lasso.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An established network affiliate program aimed at women's-health bloggers and creators; no public UGC campaign details found.

description: Chef-driven marketplace for healthy prepared meals: sustainably sourced, nutritionally dense, ready-to-heat meals created by local chefs and restaurants, delivered by subscription.

evidence.summary: Territory's own partner page announces 'We've recently launched our new affiliate program' with competitive commissions, exclusive audience discounts and a dedicated partnership team, alongside a separate Influencer track for wellness, fitness and health professionals.

Territory's own affiliate program document states the program runs on Impact Radius, is free to join, pays $20 for every qualified new customer referred, and allows referrals from clicks within 30 days; LinkClicky independently lists the same $20-per-sale Impact program.

Note: Territory's separate Ambassador track pays in Territory credit (10% commission in credit, $25 credit per first order; credit redeemable for cash at only 25% of value) — the entry here is based on the cash-paying Impact affiliate program, not the credit-based ambassador track.

reasons.credibility: Established meal-delivery company describing itself as the leading healthy prepared meal company, with chef marketplace model.
reasons.niche_fit: Healthy prepared-meal delivery is a proven creator niche across wellness, fitness and busy-professional audiences.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Newly relaunched program actively recruiting partners; free to join via Impact.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Brand runs both a network affiliate program and an influencer track, and promotes partner content on its social channels.

description: Ayurvedic wellness brand best known for Tulsi (holy basil) teas and herbal supplements such as ashwagandha and psyllium; a Certified B Corporation using regenerative organic farming, with a U.S. operation selling direct and through TikTok Shop.

evidence.summary: Rateful's TikTok Shop data page for Organic India USA reports that about 93% of the brand's estimated $14.1K in TikTok Shop sales in the 30 days to Nov 6, 2026 came through affiliate creators' videos and LIVEs (791 items sold, ~$17.81 average price) — creators with TikTok Shop affiliate access can add its products to their showcase and earn commission on every sale. No commission percentage is published.

Green Affiliate Programs describes Organic India's U.S. program history on ShareASale (5%, 60-day cookie) but currently marks that listing Inactive, and affiliate-toolkit lists an Admitad route — so the live, verifiable creator route recorded here is the TikTok Shop affiliate program, with the rate unpublished.

reasons.compensation: No commission rate is published in any fetched source — TikTok Shop rates are set per product inside the platform — so compensation scores low despite real payouts.
reasons.contact_access: No public creator contact or application page found; joining happens inside TikTok Shop's affiliate center.
reasons.credibility: Certified B Corporation with 25+ years in Ayurvedic products and a large catalog.
reasons.niche_fit: Tulsi teas and Ayurvedic supplements sit squarely in the wellness niche with strong stress/sleep/gut content angles.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open to any creator with TikTok Shop affiliate access; free samples can be requested through the affiliate center per Rateful.
reasons.ugc_evidence: TikTok Shop sales are overwhelmingly creator-driven (93% via affiliate videos and LIVEs per Rateful's data), showing an active creator engine.

description: Bone broth brand (Au Bon Broth, LLC, a Delaware company) selling broth products direct to consumers online, marketed to wellness, keto and carnivore audiences.

evidence.summary: Au Bon Broth's own published Affiliate Agreement (last updated Mar 6, 2023) sets the General Affiliate commission at 20% of the total sale amount excluding taxes and fees, paid in USD on the 1st and 15th of each month after a 45-day refund window. Caution terms: a $100 minimum must be reached, and commissions under $100 within a 120-day period are forfeited; affiliates must use @AuBonBoneBroth / #AuBonBoneBroth and #ad disclosures on social posts.

name: Au Bon Broth

opportunity.title: Au Bon Broth Affiliate Program — 20% commission, brand-direct (own published affiliate agreement; $100 payout minimum)

reasons.compensation: 20% of the sale amount on the brand's own published agreement — a high, verified rate; held back by the $100 minimum and a 120-day forfeiture clause.
reasons.contact_access: Published support email and the full program agreement on the brand's own site.
reasons.credibility: Terms date from March 2023 and the forfeiture clause is unusually harsh, so credibility is scored conservatively.
reasons.niche_fit: Bone broth fits wellness, keto and gut-health content, though it is a narrower single-product niche.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application-based with approval at the brand's discretion ('not everyone who applies will qualify').
